LESSON: EATING HABITS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.2: Eating habits

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Eating habits. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name foods and drinks they consume on a daily basis,
2. mention their likes and dislikes of food and drinks they eat at good and bad for their teeth. home,
3. choose healthy food for strong teeth,
4. appreciate healthy food for teeth. the foods and drinks they choose to eat that are healthy for their teeth. drinks they like or dislike using computing devices and display in class. healthy for their teeth using computing devices and display in class. Core-Competence to be developed Self-efficacy, Critical thinking, Communication and collaboration; Digital literacy

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Eating habits.
2. Explain Eating habits to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Eating habits.
4. Show that you can: name foods and drinks they consume on a daily basis,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Eating habits. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Eating habits important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
